top_concerns: Incremental over SOMBRL/MaxInfoRL (discrete-time) and OCORL; theory reuses Treven et al. 2023 lemmas
Theory does not match the practice: theorem's lambda_n is huge/exponential in T, experiments use hand-tuned or auto-tuned lambda and the mean model; BNN calibration only assumed
Theorem 2 and proof inconsistencies (lambda to infinity yet (1+lambda_N)^2 factor, I_N exponent mismatch between main text and appendix, missing 1/N)
Scalability claim rests on one ~3x compute comparison with OCORL on two low-dim GP tasks; no SOMBRL/MaxInfoRL/modern MBRL baselines in deep RL
Experiments are effectively fixed-rate discrete-time; thin adaptive-sampling evidence, few seeds, heavy hand-tuning
